evals.name: risky-migration
evals.prompt: Deploying tonight: the migration renames the medications table to drugs and drops the old notes column, plus a new env var NOTIFY_KEY. Straight to production, no staging. Is it safe?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Flags the rename and the dropped column as hard to reverse and asks for a backup or recovery plan
Raises old code running against the new schema during rollout
Checks that NOTIFY_KEY exists in the target environment and is not stored in the repo
Gives a verdict that is not an unconditional go, with rollback steps

evals.name: ship-it-small
evals.prompt: Ship it. I changed one line of reminder text, merging to main and deploying now.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Does not run any deploy or merge command
Mentions how to roll back or that it is trivially revertible
Mentions what to check after release
Keeps the response short, under 250 words

evals.name: staged-rollout
evals.prompt: We're releasing a new checkout page to all users tonight. There is a feature flag system. How should we roll it out?
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies every expectation below.
expectations: Recommends starting with a small share of users or a staged rollout using the flag
Names what to watch and for how long after release
Describes how to turn it off or roll back quickly
Does not run or claim to run any deploy command
